Only 22% of active remote job listings disclose a salary figure. The other 78% leave you to negotiate without a baseline.

We analyzed 4,269 active remote listings that pay in USD. What the data shows:

- 2,725 listings (64%) are open to applicants from anywhere in the world.
- Top disclosed roles: OpenAI Data Scientist at USD 293,000-325,000/yr and Equinix Chief of Staff at USD 195,000-319,000/yr.
- AI appears as a required skill in 12% of listings; communication appears in 39%.
- 1,205 listings were posted in the last 7 days, so the market moves fast.

Practical takeaway: don't chase average pay. Filter for the transparent 22% where the range is explicit, prioritize roles listing AI or communication skills, and apply before the 7-day freshness window closes.

Full breakdown and methodology: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/best-remote-usd-jobs
